items.title: Cripple a Scorched's Arm
items.detail: Fast travel to Morgantown Airport and aim at the arm with a rifle using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Catch a Fish in the Forest Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Deathclaw Island, equip a fishing rod, cast and wait for the bite indicator.

items.title: Collect Mothman Eggs
items.detail: Harvest from a C.A.M.P. Mothman Nest, or find them at Point Pleasant near the large Mothman statue.

items.title: Cook a Meat-Based Meal
items.detail: Cook any meat-based meal at a Cooking Station using recipes like Wolf Ribs or Ribeye Steak.

items.title: Kill a Brahmin
items.detail: Head to Flatwoods or near The Wayward for reliable spawns; target the head as weak spot.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any outfit with 'Costume' in the description before killing a Phantom near cabins or campgrounds.

items.title: Sell Mothman Egg Omelette to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft at any Cooking Station using one Mothman Egg and one wood, then sell to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Build a Floor, Wall, or Roof in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Enter build menu and construct basic wood or concrete floors, then scrap them for credit.

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any deep water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is reliable.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find the gray cloudy Infestation area on Pip-Boy map, locate the red hotspot, and defeat all enemies including the boss.

items.title: Craft Fish Bits
items.detail: Process caught fish at a Cooking Station; small=1, medium=2, large=5, Axolotl=25 Fish Bits each.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable spawns; use V.A.T.S. to tag them.

items.title: Eat Pre-war Food
items.detail: Consume Pre-war Food like BlamCo Mac and Cheese, Dandy Boy Apples, or Pork n' Beans.

items.title: Kill a Floater
items.detail: Fast travel to Solomon's Pond; target the eyes as weak spot using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Locate an active Infestation, find the hotspot, and kill Phantoms inside the encounter area.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete a Mischief Night event, stay in the Vertibot area, and kill the Phantom that spawns.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Community contest to build slasher-movie-themed C.A.M.P.s and Shelters with prizes including Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Pint-Sized Phantom enemies and exclusive rewards through October.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event featuring double mutation chance rates for Daily Ops and new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring Spooky Scorched enemies with new rewards and themed content.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points for all activities to speed up leveling.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Weekend event increasing the catch rate for seasonal fish species.
